ui.title.tagline: A strange signal. A lost civilization. Fly with gravity and find out what happened to the Orrin.
ui.track.explain: You can change this any time in Settings. Same science, different challenge.
ui.track.cadetDesc: More fuel, longer aiming guide, friendly words. Great for ages 10–12.
ui.track.commanderDesc: Real units, tighter fuel, shorter guide. For ages 13–16 and up.
ui.map.title: Galaxy Map
ui.map.label: Orrin worlds
ui.map.lockedHint: Finish the previous world to unlock this one.
ui.map.replayQ: You've solved this world. Replay it?
ui.sky.title: Look up tonight
ui.sandbox.locked: Finish Cinder to unlock the Sandbox.
ui.fly.canvasLabel: Flight map. Drag anywhere to aim your ship, release to fire the engine.
ui.fly.heat: Too hot! You're too deep in the air
ui.fly.objective.land: Goal: touch down on the glowing planet, slowly.
ui.fly.objective.orbit: Goal: stay in the orbit ring for a few seconds.
ui.fly.objective.hohmann: Goal: settle into the outer ring.
ui.fly.objective.aerobrake: Goal: use the air to slow down and get caught in orbit.
ui.fly.objective.lagrange: Goal: stay in the moving calm spot.
ui.fly.objective.escape: Goal: get past the dashed circle.
ui.inv.title: Investigate
ui.inv.pickTool: Pick a scanner tool, then tap a place to scan.
ui.inv.tapHotspot: Now tap a place in the scene to scan it.
ui.inv.nothing: The {tool} finds nothing unusual here. (No charge used.)
ui.inv.noCharges: Out of scan charges! Time to build your case.
ui.inv.outOfCharges: That was your last charge. Open the Case Board!
ui.inv.layersNext: Tap a layer below to add it here
ui.inv.layersWhy: The first Orrin city is under the impact layer, and the rebuilt city is above it. So the Orrin SURVIVED the asteroid! Bonus: +1 scan charge.
ui.inv.layersWrong: Not quite. Remember: new layers pile up on top of older ones.
ui.inv.glyphWrong: The glyph stays dark. Look at the pattern again.
ui.board.title: Case Board
ui.board.how: Drag a clue onto a hypothesis (or tap a clue, then tap a hypothesis). Pin at least 2 clues, then choose.
ui.board.slotAria: {h}, {n} clues pinned. Tap to pin the selected clue.
ui.board.needMore: Pin {n} more clue(s) to this idea first. Scientists need evidence!
ui.board.consequence: Because the crew prepared for the wrong threat, the colony starts with fewer supplies.
ui.hypd.unknown: Honest answer: ask Earth for help.
ui.col.title: Build & Survive
ui.col.penalty: Supplies are low: the crew prepared for the wrong threat.
ui.col.hint: Tap a module, then tap an empty plot. Keep oxygen, water and food above zero!
ui.col.pickFirst: Pick a module from the list first.
ui.col.wonBody: Balancing power, water, oxygen and food: that's what real space habitats have to do.
ui.colony.chain.night: Night fell and the batteries ran dry
ui.colony.chain.power: Not enough power for every module
ui.rep.title: Report to Earth
ui.rep.rulerIntro: Light is the fastest thing there is, but space is BIG. Slide to see how long light takes.
ui.rep.rulerSub: for light (and radio messages) to make this trip
ui.rep.roundTrip: Earth is {ly} light-years away. A question there and an answer back takes {y} years!
ui.rep.msgIntro: Choose up to 3 questions. The answers will arrive in {y} years. We can't wait, so the mission goes on!
ui.rep.meanwhile0: The message crawls across space at the speed of light…
ui.rep.late: MC-1 is always late. It's not their fault: light just takes time!
ui.rep.nvtTitle: Now vs. as seen from Earth
ui.rep.seen: As seen from Earth (light that left {ly} years ago)
ui.rep.seenExplain: Earth's telescopes see this star as it was {ly} years ago. That's when this light set off.
ui.rep.nowChanged: Up close it's bigger and redder. Earth won't see this change for decades!
ui.rep.nowSame: Not much has changed in {ly} years. Stars usually change very slowly.
ui.rep.phIntro: When a planet passes in front of its star, the starlight dips. Tap two dips in a row from the SAME planet (same depth) to measure its year.
ui.rep.chartAria: Star brightness over time with small dips
ui.rep.markDips: Tap a dip on the graph.
ui.rep.markOneMore: Now tap the next dip of the same depth.
ui.rep.noDip: No dip there. Look for where the line drops.
ui.rep.differentDips: Those dips have different depths, so they're different planets! Pick two that match.
ui.rep.notNeighbours: Pick two dips right next to each other.
ui.rep.measured: That planet's year is about {d} days, and it's the {size} of the two worlds.
ui.rep.whichWorld: Which world is the Orrin signal coming from? (It's the one you measured.)
ui.rep.foundBody: You used the transit method, the way astronomers have found thousands of real planets.
ui.rep.otherPlanet: That's the planet you measured, but the signal comes from the other one. Measure its dips instead!
ui.rep.checkMeasure: Check your measurement: does that year length match?
ui.rep.dipList: Can't tap the graph? Pick dips from a list
ui.forge.title: Forge a Star
ui.forge.coach: Set the mass, add hydrogen, then cook!
ui.forge.noFuel: No fuel! Add at least {n} hydrogen.
ui.forge.wrongType: Tasty, but the ship needs: {need}. Try a different mass!
ui.forge.gIntro: Drag the planet to where water stays liquid: not too hot, not too cold.
ui.forge.place: Place planet & watch billions of years
ui.forge.notInZone: Put the planet inside the green zone first.
ui.forge.leftBehind: After about {n} billion years the star had grown so bright that the zone moved past your planet. Its water would boil away, just like on Veil.
ui.forge.stillOk: Your planet stayed in the zone for the star's whole main life. Lucky world!
ui.forge.steady: Red dwarfs barely change for a very long time, so the zone stayed put!
ui.forge.gLesson: This is what happened to the Orrin: their star slowly brightened and the safe zone moved away from them.
ui.deb.title: Mission Debrief
ui.deb.offer: The crew has 3 quick questions for you. Totally optional, just for fun.
ui.deb.logbookHint: New facts and clues are in your Logbook.
ui.log.fragmentLocked: Not decoded yet. Find the glyph wall on this world.
ui.log.noFacts: Discoveries you make will appear here.
ui.log.noClues: Clues you scan will be archived here.
ui.log.redHerring: Red herring: true, but not the answer
ui.log.placeholder: Placeholder art. A real space photo goes here.
ui.gate.title: Grown-ups only
ui.par.gateIntro: Progress, concepts mastered and play time. Everything stays on this device.
ui.par.title: Parent & Teacher report
ui.par.privacy: No accounts, no internet, no data leaves this device.
ui.par.noData: ECHO DRIFT has no ads, no in-app purchases, no chat and no tracking.
ui.set.privacy: ECHO DRIFT collects no personal data. Progress is saved only on this device.
ui.sb.how: Tap to drop worlds. Choose 🚀, then drag back from a spot and let go to launch. No score, just play!
ui.err.title: Houston, we have a problem
ui.err.body: Something went wrong on this screen. Your progress is saved.
ui.err.storage: Progress can't be saved in this browser (storage blocked). You can still play.
ui.err.content: {n} content problem(s) found. See the debug menu.
